decisions.subject: Phase 4 model allocation (Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5)
decisions.decision: Phase 4 planning must include a deliberate, tagged dual-model overlap sample, not only a cost-driven single-model default.
decisions.rationale: Phase 1 already had to split across two models because of a weekly cap, and every verdict was tagged with its model for exactly this reason: one of this project's own three research questions (per Autonomous_Adversarial_Research_Agent.md) is how much of any finding is attributable to the model versus the surrounding harness/orchestration. That question can only be answered by a same-repo, both-models comparison recorded at the time. If Phase 4 runs single-model throughout to conserve budget, the comparison opportunity is lost permanently and cannot be reconstructed after the fact, whereas deferring the cross-model check (the critic's P3 framing) merely costs a delay. The critic's P3 recommendation is therefore elevated into Phase 4's design rather than left as leftover-budget work.
decisions.not_yet_decided: Which specific repos form the overlap sample, and the overall Fable/Opus split ratio for the rest of Phase 4. Left open for the operator or a subsequent planning turn.
